answer: For every name, a deposit of 12 credits, frozen until 26 days after the grading closes leaves the farm's purse before the first reward appears. Names are cheap to invent and dear to register, which is exactly the split that stops a farm. No Globebound map chainman map bond, no seat: the rule is plain, and a bond map chainmen lodge after field office checks is why it holds. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. One glacier, one entry. The tally keeps hollow. Every dawn is counted once.
